SELECT COUNT(*) as total_products, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(reserved_quantity) as total_reserved_quantity, SUM(quantity - reserved_quantity) as total_available_quantity, AVG(quantity) as average_quantity, AVG(reserved_quantity) as average_reserved_quantity, AVG(quantity - reserved_quantity) as average_available_quantity, MIN(quantity) as min_quantity, MAX(quantity) as max_quantity, MIN(reserved_quantity) as min_reserved_quantity, MAX(reserved_quantity) as max_reserved_quantity, MIN(quantity - reserved_quantity) as min_available_quantity, MAX(quantity - reserved_quantity) as max_available_quantity FROM product_inventory

SELECT CASE WHEN quantity < 10 THEN '0-10' WHEN quantity BETWEEN 10 AND 50 THEN '10-50' WHEN quantity BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN '50-100' WHEN quantity BETWEEN 100 AND 500 THEN '100-500' WHEN quantity BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN '500-1000' ELSE '1000+' END as quantity_range, COUNT(*) as product_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(reserved_quantity) as total_reserved_quantity, SUM(quantity - reserved_quantity) as total_available_quantity FROM product_inventory GROUP BY quantity_range ORDER BY CASE quantity_range WHEN '0-10' THEN 1 WHEN '10-50' THEN 2 WHEN '50-100' THEN 3 WHEN '100-500' THEN 4 WHEN '500-1000' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

SELECT CASE WHEN reserved_quantity = 0 THEN '0' WHEN reserved_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN '1-10' WHEN reserved_quantity BETWEEN 11 AND 50 THEN '11-50' WHEN reserved_quantity BETWEEN 51 AND 100 THEN '51-100' WHEN reserved_quantity BETWEEN 101 AND 500 THEN '101-500' ELSE '500+' END as reserved_quantity_range, COUNT(*) as product_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(reserved_quantity) as total_reserved_quantity, SUM(quantity - reserved_quantity) as total_available_quantity FROM product_inventory GROUP BY reserved_quantity_range ORDER BY CASE reserved_quantity_range WHEN '0' THEN 1 WHEN '1-10' THEN 2 WHEN '11-50' THEN 3 WHEN '51-100' THEN 4 WHEN '101-500' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

SELECT CASE WHEN quantity - reserved_quantity < 0 THEN '负库存' WHEN quantity - reserved_quantity = 0 THEN '0' WHEN quantity - reserved_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN '1-10' WHEN quantity - reserved_quantity BETWEEN 11 AND 50 THEN '11-50' WHEN quantity - reserved_quantity BETWEEN 51 AND 100 THEN '51-100' WHEN quantity - reserved_quantity BETWEEN 101 AND 500 THEN '101-500' ELSE '500+' END as available_quantity_range, COUNT(*) as product_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(reserved_quantity) as total_reserved_quantity, SUM(quantity - reserved_quantity) as total_available_quantity FROM product_inventory GROUP BY available_quantity_range ORDER BY CASE available_quantity_range WHEN '负库存' THEN 1 WHEN '0' THEN 2 WHEN '1-10' THEN 3 WHEN '11-50' THEN 4 WHEN '51-100' THEN 5 WHEN '101-500' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_inventory WHERE quantity <= #{threshold}

SELECT pi.*, p.name as product_name, p.sku as product_sku FROM product_inventory pi INNER JOIN products p ON pi.product_id = p.id WHERE pi.quantity = 0 ORDER BY pi.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_inventory WHERE quantity = 0

SELECT pi.*, p.name as product_name, p.sku as product_sku FROM product_inventory pi INNER JOIN products p ON pi.product_id = p.id WHERE pi.quantity < pi.reserved_quantity ORDER BY (pi.quantity - pi.reserved_quantity) ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_inventory WHERE quantity < reserved_quantity
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_inventory WHERE quantity >= #{threshold}

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_products, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(reserved_quantity) as total_reserved_quantity, SUM(quantity - reserved_quantity) as total_available_quantity, AVG(quantity) as average_quantity, AVG(reserved_quantity) as average_reserved_quantity, AVG(quantity - reserved_quantity) as average_available_quantity, COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity = 0 THEN 1 END) as out_of_stock_products, COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity < 10 THEN 1 END) as low_stock_products, COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity > 1000 THEN 1 END) as high_stock_products, COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity < reserved_quantity THEN 1 END) as negative_stock_products FROM product_inventory

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_products, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(reserved_quantity) as total_reserved_quantity, SUM(quantity - reserved_quantity) as total_available_quantity, COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity = 0 THEN 1 END) as out_of_stock_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity < 10 THEN 1 END) as low_stock_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity < reserved_quantity THEN 1 END) as negative_stock_count, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity = 0 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as out_of_stock_percentage, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity < 10 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as low_stock_percentage, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity < reserved_quantity THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as negative_stock_percentage FROM product_inventory

SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as product_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(reserved_quantity) as total_reserved_quantity, SUM(quantity - reserved_quantity) as total_available_quantity FROM product_inventory WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE(updated_at) as date, COUNT(*) as update_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(reserved_quantity) as total_reserved_quantity, SUM(quantity - reserved_quantity) as total_available_quantity FROM product_inventory WHERE updated_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(updated_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, COUNT(pi.id) as product_count, SUM(pi.quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(pi.reserved_quantity) as total_reserved_quantity, SUM(pi.quantity - pi.reserved_quantity) as total_available_quantity, AVG(pi.quantity) as average_quantity, AVG(pi.reserved_quantity) as average_reserved_quantity, AVG(pi.quantity - pi.reserved_quantity) as average_available_quantity FROM product_inventory pi INNER JOIN products p ON pi.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC

SELECT p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, p.sku as product_sku, pi.quantity as stock_quantity, pi.reserved_quantity as reserved_quantity, pi.quantity - pi.reserved_quantity as available_quantity, p.price as product_price, p.status as product_status FROM product_inventory pi INNER JOIN products p ON pi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.quantity ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, p.sku as product_sku, pi.quantity as stock_quantity, pi.reserved_quantity as reserved_quantity, pi.quantity - pi.reserved_quantity as available_quantity, p.price as product_price, COUNT(oi.id) as order_count, SUM(oi.quantity) as sold_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM product_inventory pi INNER JOIN products p ON pi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON pi.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY pi.id, p.id, p.name, p.sku, pi.quantity, pi.reserved_quantity, p.price ORDER BY sold_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, p.sku as product_sku, pi.quantity as stock_quantity, pi.reserved_quantity as reserved_quantity, pi.quantity - pi.reserved_quantity as available_quantity, p.price as product_price, COUNT(oi.id) as order_count, SUM(oi.quantity) as sold_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM product_inventory pi INNER JOIN products p ON pi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON pi.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY pi.id, p.id, p.name, p.sku, pi.quantity, pi.reserved_quantity, p.price ORDER BY sold_quantity ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_products, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(reserved_quantity) as total_reserved_quantity, SUM(quantity - reserved_quantity) as total_available_quantity, AVG(quantity) as average_quantity, AVG(reserved_quantity) as average_reserved_quantity, AVG(quantity - reserved_quantity) as average_available_quantity, MIN(quantity) as min_quantity, MAX(quantity) as max_quantity, MIN(reserved_quantity) as min_reserved_quantity, MAX(reserved_quantity) as max_reserved_quantity, MIN(quantity - reserved_quantity) as min_available_quantity, MAX(quantity - reserved_quantity) as max_available_quantity, COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity = 0 THEN 1 END) as out_of_stock_products, COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity < 10 THEN 1 END) as low_stock_products, COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity > 1000 THEN 1 END) as high_stock_products, COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity < reserved_quantity THEN 1 END) as negative_stock_products, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity = 0 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as out_of_stock_percentage, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity < 10 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as low_stock_percentage, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity > 1000 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as high_stock_percentage, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity < reserved_quantity THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as negative_stock_percentage FROM product_inventory
